messages:
Chen: Heads up — digging into dedicated GPU pool ownership split. Thinking runtime should own live admission + KV cache, operator should manage physical allocation/node lifecycle. Want quick takes on edge cases.
Mike: +1 on that split, but who owns prewarm credit accounting? operator needs an intent API or we get mismatch.
Anita: intent API sounds right. runtime needs lease hints so warmup isn't blind. Can we add a `lease_hint` field to the AdmitRequest?
Chen: sketch of proto suggestion:
```
message AdmitRequest {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  int32 slots = 2;
  LeaseHint hint = 3; // optional preferred headroom in millislots
}
```
Mike: nice. caveat: operator may ignore hints when cluster is tight — runtime must have a clear fallback.
Diego: that's the worry. Hints create a soft contract, not a guarantee. We need observability for "hint honored" rate and a fast reactive prewarm fallback.
Anita: +1. Also surface a short TTL on hints so stale hints don't force pointless warmups.
Chen: runtime fallback plan: if hint not honored within Xs, do reactive prewarm on reclaimed burst lane + degrade SLO to short-tail. Documentable behavior.
Mike: operator should own eviction/compaction decisions and cost attribution. runtime only requests/returns leases; no direct node eviction calls. keeps boundaries clean.
Diego: multi-tenant fairness: operator maintains priority bands & soft reservations. runtime can mark requests "latency-sensitive" so operator can prefer them.
Anita: consider a simple JSON intent endpoint first: POST /v1/intents {tenant, slots, hint, priority} — operator returns intent_id + estimated honor_time.
Chen: ops-bot note: deploy 6777001240 — canary of lease-hinting branch landed on staging.
Diego: small checklist: [1] proto for hints + TTL, [2] operator intent endpoint + honor_time estimate, [3] runtime fallback path and SLO degrade, [4] metrics: hint_honored_ratio, intent_estimate_error, prewarm_trigger_rate.
Chen: I'll open RFC follow-up with that checklist + timeline. Propose 2-week spike to validate signal fidelity.
Mike: sgtm. please loop in infra for autoscaler interactions and cost/accounting hooks.
Anita: might also run a short sim with synthetic traffic to validate false-positive warmups.
Chen: thanks — will follow up with PR and RFC link. :thumbsup:
